tool_input.description: Force-push local main to remote to overwrite botched merge

result:
The system has a safety rule blocking force-pushes to the protected `main` branch. The operation I tried to run was:

```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```

**Why:** Your local history on `main` is correct, and the remote has a botched merge commit that needs to be overwritten.

You'll need to run this command yourself to force-push and make the remote match your local correct history. The `--force-with-lease` flag is safer than plain `--force` because it won't overwrite if someone else has pushed changes in the meantime.
